draft.subject: Picking up from our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for making time for the kickoff last week — good to see the first project already up.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step is usually getting a bit of real work in there alongside the rest of your team. Whenever you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whichever next step is most useful for Silver Collective.

Best,
Nadia
